freeze.definitions: Literal U descending positive columns F(h) with all decoded drops including tail in0..4; C exact ascending nonnegative length-a/length-b increments; A/B literal gap/residue predicates. Covered iff RR005 split F-root empty. Root tables count literal F objects once, full-object tables count every descendant separately.
checks: all executed input, normal-form reconstruction, endpoint and restricted-map weights <= current ceiling
full literal U/C/A/B rows and equal denominators diagnostics
restricted map both inverse identities on covered U
author-only RR003 endpoints both roundtrips, conditional A/B coverage
literal F root rows and all aggregates compare saved exposed RR005 data only within current ceiling
explicit F_C grammar equals reviewed predecessor test
empty, zero padding, repetitions and terminal drops remain literal membership obligations
freeze.refinements: Disjoint bins on each side: U column distinct/repeated, C within-mu or within-nu repeated increments including zeros, A literal distinct/repeated parts, B literal distinct/repeated parts. These bins are not identified across sides. Additional a,b bins disjoint; root weight and boundary gap data cross-tabulations may overlap.
freeze.assurance: No new U-C rule. Endpoint transported results retain RR003 author-only dependency. Finite exposed checks are not universal proofs.
